adaptation_notes: Independent PyTorch structure adaptation of the official R/mxnet network (same as frozen tag wheat2000-deepgs-protocol-20261105); not a bitwise mxnet reproduction.

Official defaults num_round=6000, batch=30, SGD lr=0.01 momentum=0.5 wd=1e-5, uniform init 0.01, early stop after 600 non-improving epochs (official monitor mae on training batches; here validation PCC per protocol).
Raw 0/1 markers, fit-only phenotype standardization, MSE loss; official mxnet uses LinearRegressionOutput (L2) on raw targets.
Selection by validation PCC and median-epoch full-dev refit follow the Wheat599 protocol, not the official workflow.
